successors.name: Khwarazmian Empire
successors.text: Kerman province: Kerman, Bardasir (Bardsir), Bam, Jiroft

ledger.x: 1041: Qavurt founds the Kerman Seljuk sultanate.
1053: Oman comes under the Kerman Seljuks.
1154: Oman leaves the Kerman Seljuks (the page's 1053-1154 span); the nabhani-dynasty dossier begins in 1154.

wars.name: Battle of Kerj Abu Dulaf
wars.outcome: Malik Shah defeated Qavurt's forces near Hamadan on 16 May 1073; Qavurt was arrested and executed.

wars.name: Qavurt's rebellions against Alp Arslan
wars.outcome: Qavurt begged forgiveness in December 1064, rebelled in 1067 minting coins in his own name, was pardoned and kept as governor of Kerman, and rebelled again c.

wars.name: Qavurt's invasion of Fars
wars.outcome: The Qavurt page dates the invasion of Fars to 1053 in one reference and 1062 in another; in 1062 Shiraz was handed over to him.

wars.name: Ghuzz conquest of Kerman
wars.outcome: Malik Dinar seized Kerman in 1186 and Muhammad-Shah withdrew to Bam; the Khwarazmians annexed Kerman in 1196.

certainty.note: Kerman province is the stable core; the Makran and Oman limits, the Hormuz coast and the Fars frontier are not defined on the pages opened.
